payload.core_mechanism_summary: Count zeros and fives. If no zero, impossible. If fives < 9, answer is 0. Else, use floor(fives/9) groups of nine fives followed by all zeros.
payload.rationale: The solution directly constructs the answer via number theory, not via search. Candidate families restrict to complete_search; search_backtracking is the least inaccurate match as the problem could be solved by backtracking to enumerate subsets.
